Decorator @ prefix (Python / TS / JS, matches function color)

Template expression ${ } / #{ } (matches variable color, like shell $)
Variable sigil $ (PHP / Perl / SCSS / Ruby etc., matches variable color)
Regexp literal delimiters / prefixes (Ruby %r{ } / /, Python r) (matches regexp color)
Python string prefix r f b u (matches string color)
Format placeholder braces (Python f-string { } / %s etc., matches variable color)
Vue event shorthand @ (needs Vue extension, matches attribute color)
YAML anchor & / alias * / tag ! prefix (matches anchor / tag color)
Diff hunk range @@ (matches body text color)
